extracted.name: Pesto Pizza
extracted.description: This delicious pesto pizza is super easy to make by spreading pesto on a pizza crust and topping with sliced tomatoes, olives, artichokes and feta.
ingredient_lines: 1 (2 ounce) can chopped black olives, drained
1 (4 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Spread pesto on pizza crust. Top with tomato, bell pepper, olives, red onion, artichoke hearts, and feta cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and browned, 8 to 10 minutes.
